# RecruitmentHub — Recruitment & Candidate Management

A Next.js 14+ app-router project with SSR, CSR, Tailwind CSS, and full form validation.

---

## File map — where to place each generated file

```
app/
  layout.tsx              ← layout.tsx
  globals.css             ← globals.css
  page.tsx                ← page-home.tsx
  candidates/
    page.tsx              ← page-candidates.tsx
  jobs/
    page.tsx              ← page-jobs.tsx
tailwind.config.ts        ← tailwind.config.ts
next.config.ts            ← next.config.ts
```
